sentences.en: And they started making a whole bunch of these games.

sentences.en: Because in 1952, Jack Strauss, who was the president of Macy's, played the game on vacation.

sentences.en: They had given some out to, like, hotels and stuff, I guess.

sentences.en: He couldn't believe that no one was selling this game.
sentences.zh: 他简直不敢相信竟然没人卖这款游戏。

sentences.en: He said, I'm going to sell it at Macy's.
sentences.zh: 他说，我要在梅西百货上架这款游戏。

sentences.en: Within a year, it had gone, I guess.
Back in ye olde version of viral.
sentences.zh: 那是老派的病毒式传播方式。

sentences.en: Since then, it has been inducted into the National Toy Hall of Fame.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，它入选了国家玩具名人堂。

sentences.en: And the game is sold in 121 countries.

sentences.en: It is available in more than 30 languages.

sentences.en: One-third went to taxes, one-third went to charity, and the last third enabled him to have an enjoyable life.

sentences.en: He also said that his wife was the best player of the game.
sentences.zh: 他还说他妻子是这款游戏玩得最好的人。

sentences.zh: 我想知道它是什么意思。

sentences.zh: 和电视奖，颁奖典礼于2010年10月17日举行。

sentences.zh: 我找到了一个红毯视频。

sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个电影节，因为它让人们关注到行业内的女性，无论她们是电影制作人，

sentences.en: Way to raise up the ladies on our show.
